queue.title: No decisions are needed from you yet
queue.text: New letters come from CRM, draft quotes from ERP, memos from colleagues.

projects.title: No projects yet
projects.text: A project appears once the client accepts the quote. The full list is in EDS · All projects.

summary.title: The summary is empty for now
summary.text: The message-to-payment funnel, stuck projects, receivables and rejection reasons for the period will appear here.

queue.title: What to do now
queue.loadErrorText: The server did not respond. Check the connection and try again.

activity.label: Today's events
activity.loadErrorText: The server did not respond. Try again later.

messages.title: No messages yet
messages.text: Hand-overs from the bot arrive here with a note, a reply timer and a Take button. The bot stays silent while a manager is in the dialog.

leads.title: No leads yet
leads.text: They come from the Telegram bot, the web form and email — or register an enquiry by hand.

clients.title: No clients yet
clients.text: Companies and contacts appear when a lead becomes a client. The card shows requests, projects, documents and correspondence.

requests.title: No requests yet
requests.text: They come from CRM and the cabinet — or create one by hand.

channels.title: No channels connected yet
channels.text: The Telegram bot, email, web form and phone will be listed here with their state and greeting texts. Services are connected in Admin.

kb.title: No articles yet
kb.text: Quick replies and bot rules by category: prices come only from the published catalog, otherwise the bot says it will ask a manager.

documents.title: No documents yet
documents.text: Letters, quotes, contracts, invoices, acts and memos are collected in one registry with filters by type and status.

inbox.title: No incoming letters yet
inbox.text: Client letters arrive from CRM after a request is created. The director adds the resolution here.

outbox.title: No outgoing documents yet
outbox.text: Approved quotes and letters to clients with an outgoing number, sending channels and the client-side status.

projects.title: No projects yet
projects.text: A project appears when the client accepts the quote: contract, invoices, act and fulfilment in one card.

drafts.title: No draft quotes
drafts.text: They arrive from ERP when the calculation is ready and all sign-offs are collected. Nothing is sent to the client without the director's approval.

approvals.title: Nothing is awaiting approval
approvals.text: Memos and other documents with an approval route will appear here.

payments.title: No invoices or payments yet
payments.text: Here the accountant confirms payments, requests the payment order and sees overdue invoices.

new.title: The document form is coming later
new.text: A memo, statement, report or letter is created here or straight from a chat message.

requests.title: No requests yet
requests.text: Requests in ERP with their stage, calculation deadline and sign-offs from stock, supply and the chief engineer.

calc.title: No calculation tasks
calc.text: They arrive after the director's resolution.

stock.title: The stock is empty for now
stock.text: Balances and reservations, supplier orders, receiving and shipments by project.

catalog.title: The catalogs are empty for now
catalog.text: Items, suppliers with quotas and price validity, crews and service providers, counterparties.

docs.title: No documents yet
docs.text: Specifications, drawings, certificates and procedures linked to items and projects.

all.title: No chats yet
all.text: A project chat is created together with the request. Team and personal chats are created on demand; client conversations run through the Telegram bot and email.

internal.title: No internal chats yet
internal.text: Project and team chats. Any message can become a memo.

external.title: No client conversations yet
external.text: Client messages from the Telegram bot and email. The bot stays silent while a manager is in the dialog.

contacts.title: No contacts yet
contacts.text: Employees with roles and presence, and client contacts with their channels.

roles.title: The role matrix will open here
roles.text: The company role matrix: system roles and roles the administrator creates.

org.title: No employees yet
org.text: The single place to grant roles: name, position, roles, CRM and ERP access, Telegram for notifications, status.

integrations.title: No integrations connected yet
integrations.text: The Telegram bot, email, file storage, backups and AI models: status, last activity, check and reconnect.

bus.title: The integration log opens here
bus.text: Event bus of CRM, ERP and EDS: subscribers, deliveries, undelivered and inbox with errors.

tickets.title: No tickets yet
tickets.text: Requests from staff to the administrator: an error, access, a suggestion.

company.title: Company details will open here
company.text: Company details, document templates, numbering and payment terms. The screen arrives when ERP settings move into the Platform.

setup.title: First-run wizard
setup.text: The administrator, your own company and five connection steps: bot, ERP, mail, AI models and the first employee.

bot.title: Bot settings will open here
bot.text: Telegram bot texts, behaviour and handoff rules, reply templates and CSV exports.

audit.title: No entries yet
audit.text: Every change will appear here: who granted a role, reset a password or changed settings, with date and time.

setup.title: First run
setup.subtitle: Four steps: administrator, ERP connection, your company, other connections. Any step can wait.
setup.companyRequired: Create your own company: documents are issued in its name, and ERP gets its details.
setup.companyUnknown: ERP has not responded yet. A new administrator gets ERP access with a delay: try again in a few seconds.
setup.companyNoRights: Only an ERP administrator can create the company. Sign in as an administrator.
companyConsequence: ERP gets your company with the “seller” type, and you become its owner.
Details, letterhead and numbering can be completed later in Admin · Company.
The wizard creates the company once: it cannot be created again.

companyErrors.FORBIDDEN: Only an ERP administrator can create the company.
companyErrors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: ERP did not respond. A new administrator gets ERP access with a delay: try again in a few seconds.
companyErrors.default: Could not create the company. Try again.
companyErrors.ERP_NOT_CONNECTED: ERP is not connected. Connect ERP first, then create the company.
companyErrors.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: The server did not respond in time. The company may already be created: the state is refreshing — if the form disappears, the company exists; otherwise try again.

setup.connectionsLead: Four setup steps: each leads to its own screen.
setup.allDone: All done: the Platform is set up.
setup.loadError: Could not load the setup state
setup.loadErrorText: The server did not respond. Try again.

bot.title: Telegram bot
bot.text: Bot token and team channel: clients write to the bot, employees get notifications.

erp.title: ERP
erp.text: Pair CRM with ERP: requests and calculations flow between the systems. A new installation needs no code.

mail.title: Mail
mail.text: One SMTP for all emails: invitations, quotes and invoices.

models.title: AI models
models.text: Model keys for the bot and suggestions.

first_employee.title: First employee
first_employee.text: Invite a colleague and give them a role. No mail — issue a temporary password.

setup.onlyAdmin: The first-run wizard is for the administrator. The director sees the setup read-only in Admin · External integrations.

banner.label: Platform setup
banner.title: Platform setup: {{done}} of {{total}} done
banner.company: Your company is not in ERP yet.
banner.hidden: Banner hidden. The wizard stays on the “First run” page in Admin (/admin/setup).

setup.erpLead: The company is created in ERP, so ERP is connected first. A new installation needs no pairing code — the "Connect ERP" button is enough.
setup.erpDone: ERP is connected. You can check the link on the integration card.
setup.erpUnknown: ERP state is unknown: CRM did not respond. Open the ERP settings and check the link.
setup.companyNeedsErpText: The company is created in ERP, so it cannot be created before ERP is connected. The form will appear here once it is.
setup.companyAlreadyCreated: Your company already exists — that is the same result, continue with the other steps.

org.title: Org structure
org.subtitle: Employees, roles and access to CRM and ERP. Roles for both systems are granted in one card.
org.readOnly: View only: an administrator changes roles and access.

empty.title: No employees yet
empty.text: One place to grant roles: name, position, roles, CRM and ERP access, Telegram for notifications, status.

noMatch.title: Nobody found
noMatch.text: Change the query or pick another status.

loadError.title: Could not load employees
loadError.text: The list comes from CRM. Try again; if the error stays, check CRM in Admin · Integrations.

cardError.title: Employee not found
cardError.text: The card may have been removed or the link is out of date. Pick an employee from the list.

card.erpPending: ERP access is still being granted.
card.erpError: ERP access could not be granted: {{error}}
card.disabledNote: The employee is disabled and cannot sign in. Roles and position are kept.

form.rolesHint: A person can have several roles: access and queues add up.
form.positionHint: Text for the card and lists; it does not affect permissions.
form.needRole: Pick at least one role. To close access completely, disable the employee.
form.lastAdmin: You are the only administrator: the Administrator role cannot be removed. Appoint another administrator first.
form.rolesError: Could not load roles from CRM.

consequence.modules: The employee will see the modules: {{modules}}.
consequence.lost: The employee will stop seeing the modules: {{modules}}.
consequence.applied: Changes: in CRM and ERP — immediately; the employee's menu updates within a minute or at the next sign-in. The CRM log records who made them and when.
consequence.positionCleared: The position on the card will be cleared.
consequence.self: You are changing your own roles: the menu updates after saving.
consequence.selfLosesAdmin: You will lose access to the Admin section.
consequence.erpAdmin: In ERP the employee becomes an administrator (superuser).
consequence.erpSections: In ERP the employee gets rights by the roles' sections; the outcome is in the card (“ERP: being granted”, “ERP: error”).

invite.title: Invite employee
invite.name: First and last name
invite.consequenceMail: An email with a temporary password goes to the address; it must be changed at first sign-in.
invite.consequenceListed: The employee appears in the list with the status “Invited”.
invite.notSent: The employee was added with the status “Invited”, but the email was not sent: mail is not connected or unavailable. Connect it in Admin · Integrations and send the invitation again from the employee card.
invite.notSentUnavailable: The employee was added with the status “Invited”, but CRM did not respond and the email was not sent. Try again later with “Send the invitation again” in the card.
invite.resendHint: A new email with a new temporary password goes out; the previous one stops working.
invite.resendNotSent: The email was not sent: mail is not connected or unavailable. Connect it in Admin · Integrations and try again.
invite.deliveryPassword: With a temporary password, no email
consequencePassword: The employee appears in the list as “Invited”; no email is sent.
You see the temporary password once: give it to the employee in person or in a secure chat.
At first sign-in the employee must set their own password.

password.title: Temporary password
password.warning: The password is shown once. Once you close this window you cannot see it again; you would have to issue a new one.
password.label: Temporary password
password.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the password and copy it manually.
password.howTo: Give it to the employee in person or in a secure chat, not by email. At first sign-in the employee must change it to their own.

issue.hint: A new password without an email: the previous one stops working.
consequence: The previous password stops working and the employee is signed out of the Platform, CRM and ERP.
You see the new temporary password once and hand it to the employee.
At sign-in the employee must set their own password; in the list they show as “Invited”.

disable.title: Disable the employee?
disable.sessions: Sign-in to the Platform, CRM and ERP will close.
disable.kept: Roles and position are kept: the employee can be enabled again.
disable.enableResult: Sign-in opens again; roles and position stay as they were.

errors.LAST_ADMIN: You cannot remove the administrator role or disable the last administrator. Appoint another administrator first.
errors.LAST_DIRECTOR: You cannot remove the director role or disable the last director. Appoint another director first.
errors.ROLES_REQUIRED: At least one role is required. To close the employee's access, disable them.
errors.EMAIL_EXISTS: An employee with this email already exists.
errors.ACTIVE_LEADS: The employee has leads in progress. Pick a colleague to hand them over to and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Not enough rights: roles are granted by an administrator.
errors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: CRM is not responding. Try again later.
errors.OWN_ACCOUNT: Your own password is changed in the profile: temporary passwords are issued to other employees.

transfer.label: Who takes over the leads in progress

roles.title: Role matrix
roles.subtitle: What each role sees and can do. Modules outside the role are hidden from the rail. One person can hold several roles — access and queues add up.
roles.caption: Role matrix: sections by module and the access level of every role
roles.systemNote: System role: its matrix is set by the Platform catalog and cannot be changed or deleted. Grant or remove it in the org chart.
roles.assign: Assign the role to an employee
roles.adminNote: Admin “full” in this role manages employees, roles and connections, but does not make an ERP superuser: only the system role “Administrator” does — in ERP this role gets only the rights of its sections. It does not give CRM leads, clients or deals — that needs a second role.
roles.readOnlySubtitle: What each role sees and can do. Roles and access are changed by the administrator.
roles.readOnlyNote: View only: the role and its matrix are changed by the administrator. Employee roles are in the org chart.

loadError.title: Could not load roles
loadError.text: Roles are stored in CRM. Try again; if the error stays, check CRM in Admin · Integrations.

notFound.title: Role not found
notFound.text: The role may have been deleted or the link is outdated. Pick a role in the matrix.

new.title: New role
new.fromHint: A template fills the new role's column with its sections; you can change them afterwards.
new.created: The role appears in the matrix and in the org chart role list; nobody holds it yet — nobody's rights change.
new.assign: Grant the role to employees in Admin · Org chart.

roles.name: Name
roles.matrixHint: Section levels and restricted fields are changed in the role's column of the matrix.
roles.renamed: The role will be called “{{name}}” for all its employees ({{count}}); rights do not change.
roles.descriptionOnly: Only the role description changes; employee rights stay the same.
roles.applied: CRM and ERP rights are recalculated right after saving; employees' menus refresh within a minute. The CRM log keeps who changed the role and when.

preview.nobody: Nobody holds the role: nobody's rights change.
preview.unchanged: Rights of employees with this role do not change: their other roles give the same sections.
preview.failed: Could not work out the consequences: CRM did not respond. Saving will still show the result.

roles.deleteBlocked: Cannot delete: the role is held by employees ({{count}}). Give them other roles in the org chart first.
roles.deleteResult: The role disappears from the matrix and the org chart role list. Nobody holds it — nobody's rights change.

errors.ROLE_IN_USE: The role is held by employees ({{count}}) and cannot be deleted. Give them other roles in the org chart first.
errors.ROLE_SYSTEM: A system role cannot be changed or deleted.
errors.NAME_TAKEN: A role with this name already exists. Choose another name.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: After this change the company would have no administrator. Keep Admin “full” or appoint an administrator.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Not enough rights: roles are changed by an administrator.
errors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: CRM is not responding. Try again later.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the role name, sections and fields.
errors.ROLE_VERSION_CONFLICT: The role was changed by someone else — refresh the page.

roles.employeesEmpty: Nobody holds the role yet. Grant it in the employee card in the org chart.

today.title: No events today yet
today.text: The company event feed will appear here: who did what and in which module.

notifications.title: No new notifications
notifications.text: Decisions, client messages and system events will appear here.

card.title: No object selected
card.text: Pick a table row and its card opens here without leaving the page.

chat.title: No chat open
chat.text: A project chat is created with the request; project events are posted to it as system messages.

documents.title: No documents
documents.text: The document chain of the selected object will be here.

resolution.title: No letter selected
resolution.text: Open an incoming letter and the resolution form with assignees and a deadline appears here.

approve.title: No quote selected
approve.text: Open a draft quote and the approval checklist and sending channels appear here.

agree.title: No memo selected
agree.text: Open a memo and the route with Approve, Return for revision and Reject appears here.

payment.title: No invoice selected
payment.text: Open an invoice and the payment order, the statement amount and Confirm payment appear here.

task.title: No calculation selected
task.text: Open a calculation and the director's resolution, sign-offs and project chat appear here.

about.title: No chat selected
about.text: Documents from the chat, participants and a short rule will appear here.

employees.title: No employees
employees.text: Employees with the selected role and the Assign role button will appear here.

role.title: No role selected
role.text: Click a role column in the matrix and the role description and its employees appear here.

journal.title: No entry selected
journal.text: Select an entry in the log to see the details here: who, when and what changed.
